summary: All four declared Checks pass and the Revision fast-forwards origin/master, but the calibration reporting path is broken. evals/scripts/calibrate_judge.py consumes a predictions schema that evals/runtime/judge.py does not emit and no collector/normalizer exists. judge.py returns dimensions as dicts (e.g. {"score":false,"reason":...}) and metadata keys judge_version/judge_model/prompt_sha256 (judge.py lines 233,311-313), while calibrate_judge.py reads dimensions[name] as a boolean (line 82,87) and judge.version/judge.model/prompt_sha256 (lines 103-105). Feeding a real judge result for a labeled failing trial produced correctness dimension agreement 0.0 despite a matching false score (because bool({"score":false}) is True), and judge_fingerprint_matched:null/regrade_required:false despite identical version/model/prompt, so the documented dimension-agreement gate and fingerprint drift detection cannot work. Required: emit the forest.eval.judge-predictions.v1 shape (flat dimension booleans plus version/model/prompt_sha256) via a collector, or make calibrate_judge.py read the judge object shape directly (dimensions[name].score, judge_version/judge_model), and add an integration test covering judge output -> calibration report.
